g.text: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY · Simulated data · No measured platform performance

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #81778c

g.text: Preserve the objection, its reason and its conditions—not just the number of dissenters.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #302a39

g.text: c Trace the reason—not only the stance

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #bd784d

g.text: A stance-only summary—“There is support and disagreement”—loses the reason and the subgroup.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #675d74

g.text: 100 hypothetical cases at six budgets; faint paths show 20 per category. Bands: IQR; bold lines: medians (a), rates (b).

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #675d74

g.text: False consensus means implying shared agreement despite unresolved source disagreement; both methods are hypothetical.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #81778c

g.text: DESIGN SIMULATION — NOT RESULTS. Category differences and method benefits are constructed, not measured.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #81778c

g.text: Panel c is an authored example. A real test needs independently annotated reasons, conditions and blinded summary judgments.
